KXCPI-26MAY-T0.4.reason: Monthly CPI has stayed mostly in the 0.2-0.4% range with sticky services inflation; >0.4% remains the more likely scenario but slightly below market.

KXCPI-26MAY-T0.5.reason: Shelter disinflation continues to weigh on CPI; a >0.5% print requires broad re-acceleration that current data does not strongly support.

KXCPI-26MAY-T0.6.reason: Exceeding 0.6% monthly requires an energy or food spike on top of services stickiness, a relatively unlikely confluence.

KXCPI-26MAY-T0.7.reason: A 0.7%+ monthly reading would represent a significant acceleration inconsistent with the prevailing disinflationary trend; slight upside vs Kalshi price.

KXCPI-26MAY-T0.8.reason: A 0.8%+ monthly print is a tail risk only; would require simultaneous energy shock plus broad core re-acceleration, in line with Kalshi pricing.
